_comment: Prices in USD per million tokens. Verify against the source URLs before trusting a cost report. cache_write is the 5-minute-TTL write price (1.25x base input); the 1-hour-TTL write price (2x base input) is given separately as cache_write_1h where available. cache_read is the cache-hit price (0.1x base input) regardless of TTL.
_disclaimer: Prices change. Update this file and re-run the report; the tool prints which pricing date it used.

_notes.long_context_1m: Claude 4.6-and-later models (Fable 5, Mythos 5, Opus 5, Opus 4.8/4.7/4.6, Sonnet 5, Sonnet 4.6) include the full 1M-token context window at standard per-token pricing -- no long-context premium tier. Earlier models are not covered by this file.
_notes.sonnet_5_pricing_history: Sonnet 5 launched at $2/$10 per MTok as introductory pricing through 2026-08-31, with a planned increase to $3/$15 on 2026-09-01. Anthropic canceled that increase on 2026-08-10 and made $2/$10 the permanent standard price -- confirmed both by the official docs page and by an official Anthropic (@claudeai) post on X.
_notes.cross_check: platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (canonical docs, most detailed table) and the official Anthropic X post agree on Sonnet 5 pricing. claude.com/pricing is client-side rendered, so its API pricing table could not be independently scraped via WebFetch to diff line-by-line -- the docs page states it mirrors claude.com/pricing#api and no contradicting figure was found anywhere else (including web search results citing the same numbers). No disagreement was found between sources for any model in this file.
_notes.fast_mode: Claude Opus 5 and Opus 4.8 support a separate 'fast mode' (research preview, Claude API only) priced at $10 input / $50 output per MTok -- not included as a distinct model entry here since it's a request-time flag, not a separate model ID.
_notes.batch_api: All models get a 50% discount on both input and output tokens via the Batch API -- not encoded here since it's a separate request mode, not a per-token list price.

claude-mythos-5.note: Limited availability (Project Glasswing / anthropic.com/glasswing). Same pricing as Claude Fable 5.

claude-sonnet-5.note: $2/$10 was introductory pricing through 2026-08-31; Anthropic made it permanent on 2026-08-10 and canceled the planned $3/$15 increase.
